component.name: Macro Tool
component.summary: Record and replay mouse and keyboard macros

description.p: An auto clicker and macro recorder for Windows, macOS and Linux, on X11 and Wayland.

ul.li: Record mouse and keyboard input once, then replay it as many times as you need
Pick click points on a frozen screenshot with a magnifier
Edit, reorder and skip steps; undo every change
Global hotkeys to start, stop and record
